tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dzambha la yab yum zung 'brel gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/

na mo badzra pā ṇi ye/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dzaṃ ser po dang baṃ ser po/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'gro ba rnams kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus nas/ tshur 'dus dzaṃ dang baṃ yig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa dzambha la sku mdog ser po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bi dza bū ra ka dang g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa'i zhabs kyis dung dang padma'i gter mnan pa/ utpa la'i phreng ba dang rin po che'i rgyan sna chogs pas brgyan pa/ de'i g.yon du yum lha mo nor rgyun ma ser mo phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon thugs kar 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ bud med sgyu ma'i rnam 'gyur gyis mdzes pa/ yab kyi dku g.yon la phyogs te zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ de gnyis kyi sbyi bor auṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā:dmar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ byang phyogs lcang lo can nas ārya dzambha la dang lha mo nor rgyun ma la nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ e hye hi ma hā kā ru ṇi ka badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis auṃ badzra a bhi ṣīñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ lus gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa a mṛ tas bsangs sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du auṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ nas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ auṃ arghaṃ āḥhūṃ zhes sogs kyis byin brlabs bya/ de nas/ auṃ ārya dzambha la ba su dha ri arghaṃ nas shapta pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod de/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*/ /gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje/ / phongs pa'i sdug bsngal zhi mdzad dzambha la/ /lha mo nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas/ rang dang nor rgyun ma'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten khams kyi dpal 'byor phun sum chogs pa thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ dzambha la dza lend+ra ye swāhā dang*/ auṃ ba su dha ri ṇi swāhā zhes pa gnyis dang grub na gzungs ring bzla ste/ de yang yab kyi gzungs ring dang*/ yum gyi gzungs ring gnyis yod cing*/ dang po la 'dra mi 'dra 'ga' re 'byung yang gcig ni/ na mo ārya dzambha la/ ma hā dzambha la/ tadya thā/ si mi si mi/ su mu su mu/ tsaṇḍa tsaṇḍa/ tsa ra tsa ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ku ru ku ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ sa da ya da ma/ ma ma na da ma/ a nante danto sa ha/ ārya dzambha la swāhā/ ma no ra ta pa ri pū ra ka swāhā zhes dang*/ yum gyi gzungs ring mang du 'dug kyang ton na phan yon che bar bshad pas brjod na/ na mo bha ga wa te/ badzra nir gho ṣe/ ta thā tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ budha ya/ tadya thā/ auṃ su be bha dra ba ti/ ba le madga la ma te/ a tsa le a tsa ba le/ ud ga ta ni/ sa bha wa ti/ dha na wa ti/ pra bha wa ti/ bi ma le/ nir ma le/ su ru su ru be/ sa bha ma le/ bi ma le/ nir ma le/ a tsante/ a nante/ bi na ma te/ bi sha ne/ shi ne she/ aṃ ku re/

mang ku re/ pra bhang ka re/ bi ra me/ bi dha ma/ ri ri me/ dhi dhi me/ dhu dhu me/ kha kha me/ ta ta kha me/ ta ra ta ra/ ta ra badzre badzre/ badzrod bha me/ ta ka ta ka tha ke tha ke u ke bug ke tha ke tha ra ke a ba ta ne/ bar sha ni/ ne tra dha ni/ saṃ ga ra nir gho ṣa ya/ ma nu sma ra sma ra/ sarba sa twa ta thā ga tā/ ma nu sma ra/ sad ta ya ma nu sma ra/ dharma sad te ma nu sma ra/ sadga sad te ma nu sma ra/ ta ṭa ta ṭa/ pu ra pu ra/ pū ra ya pū ra ya/ bha ra bha ra ṇi/ a ma le/ su mang ga le/ shanta ma ti/ shu bha ba ma ti/ madga la ma ti/ ma hā ma ti/ bha ta ma ti/ pra bha ma ti/ su tsand+ra ma ti/ ā gatstsha ā ga /tstsha/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra swāhā/ a pa ra ṇa ma nu sma ra swāhā/ pra bha ma nu sma ra swāhā/ dhi ti ma nu sma ra swāhā/ tstshe da ma nu sma ra swāhā/ dzambha ya ma nu sma ra swāhā/ hṛ da ya ma nu sma ra swāhā/ sarba sad ta ya ma nu sma ra swāhā/ auṃ ba su dha re swāhā/ auṃ shrī ba su swāhā/ auṃ ma hā ba su swāhā/ 'di mang du bzlas na 'di phyi gnyis ka la longs spyod 'byung bar bshad do/ /gzungs ring thung gnyis ka grub na rab/ min yang gzungs thung gnyis bzlas pa'i mjug tu yig brgya dang*/ slar mchod bstod bya zhing*/ gtor ma 'bul na/ a mṛ tas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i gtor snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung pa'i gtor ma zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ auṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ lcang lo can sogs rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dzam lha yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ auṃ ārya dzambha la ba su dha ri sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul te/

gong gi bstod pa de'am/ yang na/ yo byad nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /'gro ba'i dbul phongs sdug bsngal sel mdzad pa/ /dzam la nor rgyun lha mo 'khor bcas la/ /gus pas bstod do 'dod rgu'i dngos grub stsol/ /ces bstod cing 'dod don zhu/ ma rnyed ces sogs kyis bzod gsol byas nas/ ye shes pa gshegs gsol bya ba'am/ yang na/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa rnams rang yab yum la thim pas rang nyid dzambha lar gyur pa'i spyi bor auṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dzam la 'khor bcas 'grub gyur nas/ /zhes sogs bsngo smon bya'o/ /zhes 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs/ dzam la rnam pa gsum gyi sgrub thabs 'di ni/ rang nyid kyi phyag g.yon 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho dang*/ gzhi pa'i shes rab rgya mtsho gnyis kyis 'di lta bu zhig 'bri bar mdzod dang*/ nged rnam gnyis kyis par du bsgrub par bya'o zhes zer te bskul ba'i ngo bor shāka btsun bshad sgrub ming can gyis co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo/ /madga laṃ/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/dzambha la yab yum zung 'brel gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ -PAGE 152--PAGE 151--PAGE 149-
